items.title: Anthropic Announces Model Context Protocol (MCP) Open Standard
items.summary: Anthropic open-sourced the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a universal standard for connecting AI models to external data repositories and development tools. It solves the fragmentation problem of custom agent integrations by providing pre-built connectors for developer environments.

items.title: React 19 Reaches Official General Availability
items.summary: The React core team released React 19 stable, introducing native Actions, useActionState, useOptimistic, and direct Document Metadata support. Server Functions and enhanced asset preloading are now production-ready primitives across modern frameworks.

items.title: DeepSeek Releases Open-Weights Reasoning Model
items.summary: DeepSeek published technical details and weights for their latest reasoning model, matching frontier proprietary performance on math and coding benchmarks. The release demonstrates significant gains in inference-time compute scaling on commodity hardware.

items.title: TypeScript 5.7 Final Release with Unchecked Indexed Access Improvements
items.summary: Microsoft finalized TypeScript 5.7, bringing checks for uninitialized variable access, path rewriting for imports, and performance optimizations in compiler type-checking. Tooling teams report a 15% reduction in warm build times.

items.title: Node.js 22 LTS Becomes Recommended Default for Production
items.summary: Node.js 22 entered Long-Term Support (LTS) with V8 v12.4, native support for ES module require(), a built-in WebSocket client, and experimental SQLite module. Enterprise production teams are beginning broad migration from v20.
